HOW IT WORKS

Less between you
and the chain.

⌁

Straight from peers

Joins the chain's gossip and execution networks. No L1 or L2 RPC to pay for or wait on at runtime.

⌘

Checked before stored

Sequencer signatures, block hashes and receipt roots are verified. Safe and finalized heads come from L1.

▤

History and live, one API

Read ranges as Arrow tables, then follow new blocks, receipts and reorgs over gRPC.

YOUR FIRST QUERY

Ten blocks,
ten lines.

Read blocks, transactions, receipts or logs as Arrow record batches, into pandas, Polars, DuckDB or your own database.

Run your first query →
PYTHON · ARROW FLIGHTDownload
import pyarrow.flight as flight

client = flight.FlightClient("grpc://127.0.0.1:50051")
ticket = flight.Ticket(b"blocks:40000000:40000009:any")

for chunk in client.do_get(ticket):
    if chunk.data is not None:
        print(chunk.data.to_pydict())

Run your own node.

One command installs the programs and sets up a service per chain.

sudo bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://eabz.github.io/op-p2p-indexer/install.sh)"
